full_page.content:
Page 10 Cont.
Nov. 27 E'd Giddy - 42 - bowel obstruction. Has terrible pain - cannot eat Anthony Malcoun - 7 - Infantile - for two years and a half - also spinal maningitis. Quite improved but quite away from well.
Caroline Taylor - 29 - Ogelsby Ave., Chicago; - multiple sorosus; Dr's have no hope of recovery.
29 Emil Henry - 70 - Threatening and very painful cancerous jaw - seem- ingly of wonderful courage.
30 Dr. E'd W. James - 61 - of 2727 Cherry St., Toledo - heart, lungs, stomach. . Enrolls family.
30 Mrs. Julia Re - 62 - complication - unconscious for whole week; enrolled last Monday when Dr's gave a doubtful "24 hours more to live". Slowly improving.
Page 11
1944, December
Dec. 2 Mrs. Evelyn Brown - Elderly - presbterian - colitis - heart - kidnies. Wm. Gallagher - 79 - Eye trouble. . .
3 Kopp girl - left home last Mon. - has not been heard of since - phone her sister Mrs. Wright To-7-4532
4 Marie Roy - 58 - nerve-break.
Lynne Stephens - 9 - threatened with appendicitis - is on way to hospital - stops with parents and enrolls in S. Masses. Hiller Nowalski - 28 - spinal trouble ..... almost crippled.
5 Elizabeth Carschnia - 22 - wandered away from home 14 months ago. .. become homesick and is back with mother Okay. Deo G.
Page 12 Dec. Yvonne Debouaster Meininger - 33 - with two children, husband has peculiar idea of staying home with his mother.
Mrs. Alice Vankhenon - 38 - ten operations in 18 months; now seem- ingly improving - enrolled To-day in S. Masses.
